name: Attack Shark G3 Pro Tri-Mode Wireless Gaming Mouse with Charge Dock White
shortDescription: Attack Shark G3 Pro Tri-Mode Wireless Gaming Mouse with Charge Dock White (Ultra-Lightweight 59g / PixArt PAW3311 Sensor Up to 25000 DPI / Omron 100M Clicks Mechanical Switches / RGB Magnetic Charging Dock / Tri-Mode 2.4
descriptionHtml:
Attack Shark G3 Pro Tri-Mode Wireless Gaming Mouse with Charge Dock White (Ultra-Lightweight 59g / PixArt PAW3311 Sensor Up to 25000 DPI / Omron 100M Clicks Mechanical Switches / RGB Magnetic Charging Dock / Tri-Mode 2.4GHz, Bluetooth 5.2 & USB-C / 500mAh Battery / Official 1-Year Local Warranty)

Elevate your desktop aesthetic and master competitive gameplay with extreme agility using the Attack Shark G3 Pro White Tri-Mode Wireless Gaming Mouse, available at Turbo Computer Egypt backed by a full 1-Year official local agent warranty layout. Featuring an ultra-lightweight 59g egg-shell inspired ergonomic white chassis, this mouse is powered by a high-precision PixArt PAW3311 optical sensor capable of reaching up to 25,000 DPI, 400 IPS tracking speed, and 40G acceleration. Outfitted with durable Omron mechanical switches rated for 100 million clicks, a long-lasting 500mAh rechargeable battery providing up to 200 hours of continuous play, and a dedicated magnetic RGB charging dock, it connects seamlessly via low-latency 2.4GHz wireless, Bluetooth 5.2, or wired USB-C.
